name: Notebook Cell
summary: A Jupyter-style cell with optional highlighted code (python, JavaScript, TypeScript or SQL), a Run button, an execution count, and an output that is text, a table or any node, with status and timing.
useWhen: A data notebook or analysis tool where each step is a cell whose output can go stale when upstream code changes
Showing a query result or a short series inline, under the code that produced it
avoidWhen: Editing large files or needing a file tree, where code/code-block or code/shadcn-code-block fits better
Large result sets, where data-display/table or data-table-06 handles sorting and paging
